question.text: Which of the following is NOT a national commodity derivatives exchange in India?

answer.text: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Limited (MCX)
National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE)

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook lists the current national exchanges where commodity derivatives are traded as MCX, NCDEX, NSE and BSE. ICEX is not in that list, so it is the correct choice for the EXCEPT-style question. The Trap: MCX, NCDEX, NSE and BSE are all explicitly named in the workbook as current national commodity derivatives exchanges. Note: No claim about any one exchange being the largest or dominant by volume is made here, as that detail was not found in the page checked.
